reviews.classification: named-candidate HP journey and holdings delivery evidence
reviews.disposition: Keep eight native acts and selected literal-file persistence on the named isolated build; later O1/O2 repairs supersede shell Village figures/calendar failure for that candidate. Free accidental effect is not a learned method; hissing sensory ambiguity and attributed scar explanation remain observer-scoped. Existing school/trade/hash checks prove their selected inputs, not every world or installed app. Role-tier text, new place IDs, tracked-name residue and private content remain explicit. Human review, mobile, installed app and tracked dist are distinct states, not automatically missing AD43 floor requirements when an isolated candidate was rebuilt and tested.

reviews.classification: named-candidate HP journey and holdings delivery evidence
reviews.disposition: Preserve one smallest-unit purse per actual holder, denomination ladder versus exchange rate, vault/coat/shop custody and item transfer. Wand use/answering/possession are independently timed, not full spell competence or a universal allegiance law. Fame evidence is holder-specific; participant membership is a necessary bound, not proof every participant perceived or learned every private event. W4 adds actual NPC-store back-tests, but explicitly not general rumor or NPC-to-NPC cognition. Vault total/withdrawal/unstated prices are fill; 11 Galleons is a candidate result, not canon wealth. A later source-fixed amount needs compatible revision of the affected model/future with played transactions preserved or an explicit reset decision, not silent overwrite of established purse history. Existing owl/gift facts do not establish a carried owl item/delivery mechanism.
